sense: Lexeme as the abstract lexical unit in the mental lexicon, distinct from surface word forms.
the quefrency-domain representation of a signal's spectral structure
A bank of bandpass filters arranged to decompose an input signal into multiple frequency sub-bands, with each filter passing a distinct frequency range.
Frequency threshold at which a cumulative percentage (default 85%) of total spectral energy is reached, used for timbral characterization
The common clinical name for the per-frame estimated glottal-flow waveform g(n) obtained by inverse filtering of the speech signal.
Short-Time Fourier Transform is the abbreviation STFT used for the same time-frequency analysis technique as the full name; the entry stft already carves the procedure, the full name is a synonym.
